name: cluster_ctarank
desc: SM90 SR_CgaCtaId (PTX %cluster_ctarank): ptxas addresses static __shared__ through the shared::cluster window ((rank<<24)+0x400) even without clusters in source. nvvm must emit the real sreg - const-0 folding restructures divergent vote.sync regions and the valid PTX segfaults ptxas 12.2 at -O1+ (lda-cuda PTXAS_FAIL). x86: rank 0 exact under the (1,1,1)-cluster wrapper. Plain -arch=sm_90 suffices to generate the pattern.
